doc.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Who controls the system: Buffett, Soros and Halliburton
summary: They debate whether wealthy elites or war and prison corporations are in control.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: It’s getting worse.

We’re fed enough to pacify us for a minute or two and say, oh, okay. We got Obama in, or whatever. We’re pacified for a minute or two. But then when the smog clears, it’s wait a minute. We’re not that much better off. So now that you’ve raised that issue – but who are these people? Maybe this is all made up. Maybe it’s all made up. I don’t know. When you got people like Warren Buffet saying, “I got a lot of money. I want to pay more taxes.” Then there’s others now raising their hand, saying, “I got a lot of money. I want to pay more taxes.” So it’s not the Warren Buffets of the world. And this guy in Greece or wherever – not in Greece. He’s somewhere. He’s very, very wealthy. They meet in Wyoming once a year. These kinds of people.
George Soros?
Yeah, these kinds of people.
But they’re in the minority. They are people who are the entitled class, who really do have their country at heart.
Then who – if the Warren Buffets of the world, if this Soros, of them – of the world – if you get to that level of money and power, and they can’t make change . . .
They’re outnumbered.
By?

All those corporations, the ones like Dick Chaney and Halliburton and all the war industry and the prison industry. Those folks aren’t interested in that. I presume they’re not. I hope they’re not. But, as we see, those people who are getting those huge bonuses, those people who have sold all those fraudulent instruments, soon as the housing market blew open, they said, blame it on those people who shouldn’t have bought those mortgages. Well, who sold them those mortgages? Those are the folks who [?], I would say.

So you’re saying then that it’s not necessarily a bunch of very wealthy people around the country. You’re saying it’s people that’s down in the system that band together, just have things their way, to control the system.

No. I would say that those people that you just identified are being controlled by another group, and that group is that entitled group. They have the Bilderberg group and all these – Tri-Lateral Commission. There are these . . .
Tri-Lateral Commission. Yeah, I’ve been hearing about them for a long time. So you’re saying that there’s a group bigger and more powerful and with more money than the Buffets and that group.
I would say that the Warren Buffets and the George Soroses are hugely outnumbered by people who are into gain, profit, and at whatever expense.

That’s what I’m saying. If the Buffets – if they’re up here with their power and money, there are people down in the system that, even though they may have – maybe they only have hundreds of millions rather than billions . . .
But at this echelon up here, and above them, are people who have greater influence. Warren Buffet does not own Halliburton. He does not own Raytheon. He does not own Lockheed.
Halliburton is a bunch of folks.
Right.
So you’re saying it’s that bunch of folks multiplied by that many corporations around the world.
The people who are reaping benefits – being warmongers and reaping benefits.
So they are the ones who impress Washington.
I would say they are the ones who are financing their representatives and lobbyists to make sure that their agendas are carried out.
Exactly. That’s the way to impress Washington.
I don’t know how else that these folks at this upper echelon, who have the power that we talk about, are able to influence.
